assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent full-body sprite for a science-fantasy auto chess game. Subject: ONE Sword Thrall, an agile humanoid puppet vanguard in pearl-white ceramic armor over dark articulated joints, teal crystal crest on a sealed angular helmet, swept gold shoulder horns and narrow waist. It holds TWO separate curved swords, one in each hand, arms spread in a low balanced stance ready for a turning double-sword sweep. Long dark steel blades with subtle cyan edges, short grips, no shields, no axe. Original reinterpretation of an alien construct swordsman, no human face, no exposed skin. Semi-realistic painted 3D strategy miniature, crisp silhouette coherent with a black-and-emerald axe thrall. Three-quarter front view facing slightly right. Entire character, both sword tips, helmet crest and both feet inside frame with generous 10 percent margins; readable at small battlefield size. Soft upper-left lighting, restrained jade and bronze details. Actual transparent background, no floor, no base, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no logo, no UI, no additional characters.
